extDesc.message: Blurs spoilers for games, shows, films and anime on video sites, social networks and search. Nothing leaves your browser.

tagline.message: Waiting for GTA VI or a new season? Stay unspoiled.

perm_title.message: Allow Spoiler Shield on YouTube, Reddit and X

perm_hint.message: Your browser has not given access to these sites yet, so nothing is hidden there.

lv_light.message: Covers only clear spoilers (ending, death, leak…).

lv_spoilers.message: Covers spoilers and hints (story, plot, finale…). Recommended.

lv_everything.message: Covers everything about it, even trailers and news.

comments_toggle.message: Fold comments under videos and posts about what you protect

review_text.message: A short review helps others find it before they get spoiled.

privacy_line.message: Text is checked inside your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.

not_affiliated.message: Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

w_sub.message: Spoiler Shield now blurs GTA VI spoilers on YouTube, Reddit and X. Click a blurred block twice to see it. Any other game, show, film or anime can be added from the toolbar button.

w_s1.message: Videos, posts, comments and search suggestions that may spoil the game are blurred where they are.

w_s2.message: One click arms it, the second shows it. No accidental spoilers from a hover.

w_s3.message: Add a show, film or anime. Select any text and right-click “Hide as a spoiler”. Pause for 10 minutes or switch it off on a site.

w_pin.message: Tip: pin Spoiler Shield to the toolbar to see the counter and add what to protect in one click.

w_private.message: It reads the text of YouTube, Reddit and X pages inside your browser and never sends it anywhere. No account, no analytics, no ads.

media_toggle.message: Also blur pictures and videos on pages about it
